repository.project_kind: modular Ruby web server interface (Rack::Multipart::Parser, Rack::Request)

vulnerability.title: Rack::Multipart::Parser buffers an unterminated part header block without a size limit, allowing memory exhaustion
vulnerability.category_l2: unbounded MIME header buffering in Rack::Multipart::Parser#handle_mime_head (no header bytesize cap while waiting for CRLFCRLF)

severity.source: CNA (CVE List v5, GitHub_M) publishes CVSS 3.1 7.5 HIGH; NVD carries the identical vector and score from security-advisories@github.com, and the OSV GHSA record carries database severity HIGH

fix_commits.message: Fix denial of service vulnerbilties in multipart parsing: adds BOUNDARY_START_LIMIT and MIME_HEADER_BYTESIZE_LIMIT; not an ancestor of the v2.2.19 tag commit

fix_commits.branch: 2.2 branch (backport; ancestor of the v2.2.19 tag commit)
fix_commits.message: Same security series on 2.2; introduces the MIME_HEADER_BYTESIZE_LIMIT check that fixes CVE-2025-61772

fixed_releases.verified_content: Annotated tag 77139c9a peels to commit 4c4ea296. lib/rack/multipart/parser.rb at that commit is blob ba7b4794, byte-identical to the saved file, and contains MIME_HEADER_BYTESIZE_LIMIT = 64 * 1024 plus the 'multipart mime part header too large' raise. d869fed6 (the 2.2-line fix) is an ancestor of 4c4ea296; the tag content also includes c370dcd9's later retained-data limit.

vulnerability.vulnerable_commit_basis: Annotated tag 2.2.3 (tag object 4d456648) peels to 1741c580, the snapshot commit; the advisory range '< 2.2.19' contains 2.2.3, and neither fix commit is an ancestor of it

location.verification_method: Static read of lib/rack/multipart/parser.rb at the exact 2.2.3 commit and at tags v2.2.18 and v2.2.19, multipart.rb and request.rb at the snapshot commit, the 2.2-line and main-line fix patches, and git object checks (blob identity, tag peel, merge-base ancestry). No Ruby code was compiled or executed and no multipart request was sent.

critical_operation.description: 进入 MIME_HEAD 状态后，handle_mime_head 用 @sbuf.scan_until(@head_regex) 等待分片头部的空行终止符（@head_regex = /(.*?\r\n)\r\n/m，182 行）。找不到终止符时只返回 :want_read，on_read（185-188）随后把下一次读到的数据继续 @sbuf.concat 进来，整个 else 分支没有任何 bytesize 上限。由于 Parser.parse 用 BoundedIO(io, content_length) 只按请求声明的 Content-Length 截断（71 行），攻击者可以声明一个很大的长度，再发送一个永不结束的分片头（例如只有 Content-Disposition 行、始终不出现 CRLFCRLF），解析器就会把整个请求体累积在 @sbuf 中直到 OOM。相邻的 FAST_FORWARD 状态有 @bufsize（1MB）保护（224 行），MIME_HEAD 状态没有，这正是 61772 所描述的缺口。修复 d869fed6/589127f4 增加 MIME_HEADER_BYTESIZE_LIMIT = 64KB，超限抛 EOFError。

entry_point.description: 任何读取 params 的 Rack 应用在处理 multipart/form-data 请求时走 Request#POST：form_data? 为真后调用 parse_multipart（446），后者调用 Rack::Multipart.extract_multipart（request.rb 593-595）。extract_multipart 从 env 取 rack.input 和 CONTENT_LENGTH，调用 Parser.parse（multipart.rb 54）。Content-Type 边界、Content-Length 和请求体全部由客户端控制，因此攻击者可以把解析器停在 MIME_HEAD 状态并持续供数据。

trace.description: set_header(RACK_REQUEST_FORM_HASH, parse_multipart) —— multipart/form-data 请求进入解析器。
Parser.parse io, content_length, req.get_header('CONTENT_TYPE'), tempfile, bufsize, params —— 请求体和声明的长度原样传入。
BoundedIO.new(io, content_length) 只按声明的 Content-Length 截断；随后循环 on_read io.read(bufsize)。bufsize 默认 1MB（BUFSIZE，12 行），但 Content-Length 由攻击者声明。
handle_empty_content! 之后无条件 @sbuf.concat content，再 run_parser；没有任何「这段数据是否已超限」的检查。
@sbuf.scan_until(@head_regex) 在缺少 CRLFCRLF 时返回 nil，状态机回到 :want_read（258）；下一次 on_read 继续 concat，@sbuf.string 随请求体线性增长，内存无上限。

evidence.verification_method: raw file at the exact snapshot commit; git hash-object compared with git rev-parse 1741c580:lib/rack/multipart/parser.rb
supports: 364 lines, git blob 2eb38380b0c88a79aae5b4a251748fe7e9d71807 (identical to the blob at the snapshot commit)
on_read (185-188) unconditionally does @sbuf.concat content before run_parser

handle_mime_head (239-259) waits for the header terminator via @sbuf.scan_until(@head_regex) (240) where @head_regex = /(.*?\r\n)\r\n/m (182); when it returns nil the state machine returns :want_read (258) and more data is appended

the else branch has no bytesize check, so a part whose header block never ends keeps growing @sbuf for the whole declared request body; handle_fast_forward has a bufsize guard (224) but the MIME_HEAD state has none

evidence.verification_method: raw file at the exact snapshot commit
supports: Rack::Request#POST (440-457) calls parse_multipart (446) for multipart/form-data
parse_multipart (593-595) calls Rack::Multipart.extract_multipart
the Content-Type header and body are both attacker-controlled for any endpoint that reads params

evidence.verification_method: raw file at the exact snapshot commit
supports: extract_multipart (48-58) takes Rack::Request, rewinds rack.input, reads content_length and calls Parser.parse (54) with bufsize taken from RACK_MULTIPART_BUFFER_SIZE or Parser::BUFSIZE (1MB, parser.rb:12)
Parser.parse wraps the input in BoundedIO(io, content_length) (71), so the declared Content-Length is the only bound on how much data reaches the parser
the parser accumulates MIME header bytes up to that declared length, which is attacker-chosen

required_before_promotion: An independent reviewer must read lib/rack/multipart/parser.rb at 2.2.3 (commit 1741c580) and confirm handle_mime_head's else branch has no bytesize cap and that @sbuf keeps growing via on_read.
An independent reviewer must confirm the entry path Request#POST -> Multipart.extract_multipart -> Parser.parse -> MIME_HEAD with attacker-controlled Content-Type and Content-Length.
An independent reviewer must confirm v2.2.19 (blob ba7b4794) contains MIME_HEADER_BYTESIZE_LIMIT = 64 * 1024 and that d869fed6 is an ancestor of the v2.2.19 tag commit.
No formal reviews row may be written until a named independent reviewer returns a verdict.

limitations: Single-reviewer dossier; not eligible for data/vulnerabilities.jsonl yet.
No Ruby code was executed and no multipart request was sent: the memory-exhaustion impact is read from the code path and the advisory, not measured.
Only the 2.2 line was mapped. 3.1.x and 3.2.x carry the same parser family and are fixed by 3.1.17 / 3.2.2, but those files were not read here.
The 2.2 fix is a backport (d869fed6); the main-line commit 589127f4 is NOT an ancestor of the v2.2.19 tag, so fixed content was verified by tag blob plus ancestry of d869fed6.
v2.2.19's shipped file (ba7b4794) also contains c370dcd9's retained-data limit, so the tag blob differs from d869fed6's post-image (0cb5d347); the 61772 cap is present in both.
The practical bound is the request size accepted by the front-end server; the advisory lists proxy-level limits as a mitigation, and this dossier makes no claim about any specific deployment.
The advisory family also covers CVE-2025-61770 (preamble) and CVE-2025-61771 (non-file fields), which share fix commits; those root causes were not mapped here and are not claimed.
open_questions: Whether 2.2.3's FAST_FORWARD @bufsize guard (1MB) makes CVE-2025-61770 not applicable at this snapshot, since its advisory describes the preamble as unbounded.
Whether Rack::Multipart's BoundedIO plus a front-end Content-Length cap bounds the attack in common deployments.
Whether any public non-vendor analysis of this CVE exists; none is saved in sources.
